capabilities: Compile a manifest note's headings and wikilink bullets into a single book manuscript
Export the manuscript to EPUB and PDF via Pandoc with Typst, xelatex, tectonic, or weasyprint engines
Clean up inlined notes by stripping frontmatter, removing scaffolding sections, and rewriting Obsidian-only syntax
Preview the compiled manuscript and validate the current book
Configure output folder, engine paths, fonts, and per-book Pandoc arguments, including bibliography and citation style
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states the status is 'Pre-release. Unstable' and points to design and history docs in the repository for full documentation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to assemble many notes into a structured book and produce EPUB or PDF files for e-readers and printing.

relations.evidence: exports to EPUB and PDF via Pandoc
For PDF, Typst is the recommended engine — single small binary

requires.name: PDF engine (Typst recommended; xelatex, tectonic, or weasyprint alternatives)

summary: Book exporter that compiles a manifest note plus linked chapter notes into a single manuscript and exports it to EPUB and PDF via Pandoc.
